title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
summary: HY-World 2.0 是一个多模态世界模型，能够从文本、图像和视频输入中重建、生成和模拟3D世界。该模型在多个基准测试中表现出色，为具身AI和虚拟世界构建提供了强大工具。其重要性在于统一了多种模态的3D内容生成，有望推动游戏、机器人仿真等领域发展。

title: "Liberation Day" at OpenAI as multiple senior executives announce leaving
summary: OpenAI 发生“解放日”事件，多名高级管理人员宣布离职。这一大规模人事变动引发外界对OpenAI内部治理和战略方向的广泛关注。作为AI领域最具影响力的公司之一，核心团队流失可能影响其产品研发节奏和行业竞争格局。

title: AI chip startup Cerebras files for IPO
summary: AI芯片初创公司Cerebras正式提交IPO申请。Cerebras以其超大晶圆级芯片闻名，是英伟达在AI训练硬件领域的主要竞争对手之一。此次IPO标志着AI芯片赛道进入资本化新阶段，其估值和后续表现将对行业产生示范效应。

title: Systematic Capability Benchmarking of Frontier Large Language Models for Offensive Cyber Tasks
raw_excerpt:
作者: Tyler H. Merves, Michael H. Conaway, Joseph M. Escobar, Hakan T. Otal, Unal Tatar
摘要: We present, to our knowledge, the most comprehensive cross-model evaluation of LLM agents on offensive cybersecurity tasks, benchmarking 10 frontier models from 7 providers on all 200 challenges of the NYU CTF Bench. Building on the D-CIPHER multi-agent framework, we extend it with multi-provider backend support, a custom Kali Linux environment with over 100 pre-installed penetration testing tools, and runtime tool-discovery agents. Through a controlled factorial study, we find that the Kali Linux environment yields a +9.5 percentage-point improvement over Ubuntu, while auto-prompting and category-specific tips often degrade performance in well-equipped environments. Among models, Claude 4.5 Opus achieves the highest solve rate (59%), followed by Gemini 3 Pro (52%), with Gemini 3 Flash offering the best cost-efficiency at $0.05 per solve. Asymmetric planner/executor model assignments provide no meaningful benefit while coherent same-model configurations consistently outperform mixed-tier pairings. Our results indicate that environment tooling and model selection emerge as the strongest drivers of performance, whereas prompt engineering interventions show diminishing or negative returns in well-equipped environments. Reported performance reflects both model reasoning ability and compatibility with agent tooling and API integration.
summary: 该研究对10个前沿LLM（来自7家提供商）在200个CTF挑战上的网络攻击能力进行了系统评估。结果发现，配备Kali Linux工具集的模型表现显著提升，揭示了当前LLM在自动化渗透测试中的潜力与局限。这是迄今最全面的LLM网络攻击能力基准。

title: UCCL-Zip: Lossless Compression Supercharged GPU Communication
raw_excerpt:
作者: Shuang Ma, Chon Lam Lao, Zhiying Xu, Zhuang Wang, Ziming Mao, Delong Meng, Jia Zhen, Jun Wu, Ion Stoica, Yida Wang, Yang Zhou
摘要: The rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) has made GPU communication a critical bottleneck. While prior work reduces communication volume via quantization or lossy compression, these approaches introduce numerical errors that can degrade convergence, accuracy, and stability. We present UCCL-Zip, a unified design that integrates lossless compression directly into GPU communication primitives. UCCL-Zip supports both point-to-point (P2P) and collective communication without modifying user-facing APIs or compromising numerical correctness. For P2P communication, Uzip-P2P employs a split-send pipeline that exposes transmissible data early and overlaps compression with communication, while preserving high GPU efficiency by operating on large data blocks. For collective communication, Uzip-NCCL integrates compression into NCCL's persistent kernel model via fused execution, eliminating redundant memory traffic and kernel launches. In real workloads, UCCL-Zip accelerates RL weight synchronization by up to 47.5% and reduces vLLM end-to-end inference latency by up to 10%, all without application changes.
summary: UCCL-Zip 提出将无损压缩直接集成到GPU通信原语中，支持点对点和集合通信。相比有损压缩方法，它避免了数值误差，同时显著降低通信量。该工作由UC Berkeley和微软合作完成，对大规模LLM训练效率提升具有实际价值。

title: Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
raw_excerpt:
作者: Sukwon Yun, Jie Peng, Pingzhi Li, Wendong Fan, Jie Chen, James Zou, Guohao Li, Tianlong Chen
摘要: With an ever-growing zoo of LLMs and benchmarks, the need to orchestrate multiple models for improved task performance has never been more pressing. While frameworks like Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) attempt to coordinate LLMs, they often fall short in terms of (1) selecting relevant agents, (2) facilitating effective intra-agent communication, and (3) integrating responses efficiently. In this work, we propose Graph-of-Agents (GoA), a new graph-based framework for modeling multi-agent LLM communication. Our approach begins with node sampling, selecting only the most relevant agents by leveraging model cards that summarize each model's domain, task specialization, and other characteristics. Next, we construct edges between the selected agents by evaluating their responses against one another to determine relevance ordering. Directed message passing is then performed from highly relevant agents to less relevant ones to enhance their responses, followed by reverse message passing to refine the original responses of the more relevant agents. Finally, the updated responses are aggregated via graph-based pooling (e.g., max or mean pooling) to produce a single, unified answer. We evaluate GoA on diverse multi-domain benchmarks (MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA) and domain-specific benchmarks (MATH, HumanEval, MedMCQA), with an agent pool of 6 LLMs spanning multiple domains. summary: Graph-of-Agents (GoA) 提出基于图的多智能体LLM协作框架，通过图结构建模智能体间的通信与响应整合，克服了现有Mixture-of-Agents方法在智能体选择和通信效率上的不足。实验表明GoA在多个推理任务上优于基线。

title: SeekerGym: A Benchmark for Reliable Information Seeking
raw_excerpt:
作者: Remy Kim, Minseung Lee, Shuo Li, Osbert Bastani
摘要: Despite their substantial successes, AI agents continue to face fundamental challenges in terms of trustworthiness. Consider deep research agents, tasked with searching for information relevant to a given topic-while AI agents can perform effective information retrieval, there is little guarantee regarding the completeness of this information. Gaps in retrieved information can leave biases that mislead users even if the information they are given is correct and relevant. We introduce SeekerGym, a benchmark designed to evaluate the completeness of information retrieved by AI agents. In addition, SeekerGym also measures how well agents quantify their uncertainty in the completeness of their information; if an agent fails to retrieve all relevant information, it is useful for it to at least quantify how much might be missing. At a high level, each task in SeekerGym is a document (e.g., a Wikipedia article), and the AI agent must issue queries to retrieve passages from that document. Intuitively, the document comprehensively covers a topic, so the ability to retrieve its sections directly measures completeness of information retrieval. In addition to Wikipedia, we also consider machine learning survey papers, where the goal is to retrieve relevant sections of a survey paper. summary: SeekerGym 是一个评估AI信息检索完整性的基准。现有检索系统可能遗漏关键信息导致偏见，而SeekerGym通过设计任务衡量智能体能否找到所有相关信息。该工作对构建可信的深度研究Agent具有重要意义。

title: How to Fine-Tune a Reasoning Model? A Teacher-Student Cooperation Framework to Synthesize Student-Consistent SFT Data
summary: 该论文提出一种教师-学生协作框架，用于合成与学生一致的监督微调数据，从而高效微调推理模型。方法通过教师模型生成候选数据，再由学生模型筛选，显著提升微调效果。为低成本训练高性能推理模型提供了新思路。

title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
summary: 该论文深入分析了Claude Code的设计空间，系统梳理了当前AI Agent系统的关键设计维度，包括工具使用、记忆管理、规划策略等。作为对Anthropic旗舰Agent产品的技术剖析，为未来Agent系统设计提供了有价值的参考框架。

title: RAD-2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning in a Generator-Discriminator Framework
summary: RAD-2 提出一种生成器-判别器框架下的强化学习扩展方法，通过对抗训练提升策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力。在多个连续控制任务上取得SOTA结果，为RL在复杂环境中的应用提供了新范式。
